scope: R3 / UNINST-01 item 347: the uninstall preview now also reports directories another process holds open, separately from locked files
status: implemented-and-isolated-verified; no real user environment touched
gapClosed: Item 347 records that only file locks were detected. A directory another program holds open blocks deletion just as a locked file does, but the preview said nothing about it: the user saw only 目录树未能完整读取，不能确认影响范围 with no cause, or got no warning at all and watched the deletion fail.

implementation.directory_blocks_deletion: Same rule as the file probe: open with DELETE access and share_mode(7), close immediately, and count only ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION as a block. FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS is required because opening a directory with DELETE access fails with access-denied without it, which would be indistinguishable from a permissions problem.
implementation.LOCKED_DIR_RESOURCE: A distinct resource name (目录占用) rather than reusing 文件占用, because the remedy differs: a locked file is usually closed from the file, while an open directory is usually another program's working directory.
implementation.traversal: Directories are probed during the existing inventory walk, sampled under the same LOCK_PROBE_LIMIT as files so a large tree is not probed entry by entry.
implementation.twoReportPaths: Observed live during this round: a handle that permits no sharing at all blocks read_dir itself, so the walk returns Err and the observation must be reported from the error branch; a handle that allows read/write but refuses deletion lets the walk complete and is reported on the success branch. Both branches now name the directory, so the cause is stated instead of a bare 'could not read'.
implementation.equality: LOCKED_DIR_RESOURCE is stripped alongside LOCK_RESOURCE before comparing a stored preview with a fresh observation, so a program opening a folder between preview and execution cannot make a valid preview look stale.

fixtures.name: commands::tests::uninstall_preview_reports_an_open_directory_separately_from_a_locked_file
asserts: a tree nobody holds produces no 目录占用 entry, so the preview does not invent one
a handle opened with share_mode(3) (read/write allowed, delete refused) is seen by directory_blocks_deletion as a real block rather than a permissions problem
the preview names the specific folder (cache) so the user knows what to close
the details mention 工作目录, the remedy that differs from a locked file
the scope stays complete: a directory lock is reported, not used to block the preview
the directory lock is not misreported under the file-lock resource name
releasing the handle removes the entry from the next preview

fixtures.name: commands::tests::an_exclusively_held_directory_is_named_even_when_the_walk_fails
asserts: a handle opened with share_mode(0) really does make the traversal fail, asserted by scope_complete staying false rather than assumed
the 受管目录树 blocked entry is still present, so the failure is reported at all
the blocking directory is named (cache) in the blocked list, which is the whole point of the change
releasing the handle makes the scope readable again, proving the failure was the handle and not a persistent condition

discoveredDuringWork.finding: A fully exclusive directory handle (share_mode 0) makes read_dir fail, so inventory_managed_tree returns Err and the walk stops before the success-branch reporting runs.
discoveredDuringWork.howEstablished: A temporary diagnostic printed `DIAG blocks=true inv_ok=false dirs=2 locked_dirs=["cache"]`, which proved the probe itself works while the traversal fails.
discoveredDuringWork.consequence: The reporting was moved into the error branch as well, and the fixture switched to share_mode(3), which models the ordinary open-working-directory case instead of the extreme one. Recording this because the first version of the code would have silently dropped the observation in exactly the case that matters most.

rust.note: run standalone so the exit code is cargo test's own

uiAssertions: a preview with no observed directory lock must not render a 目录占用 entry
a preview reporting a directory lock renders the entry with the specific folder (cache) and the 工作目录 remedy
the count renders as （1 项） rather than being swallowed
the entry lands in the 未验证/不自动处理 section and never in 将移除, so a lock is never mistaken for something the delete will handle
notVerified: No real program held a real environment directory; both the blocking and the reported cases use synthetic handles
The two report paths are covered separately: the success branch by the share_mode(3) fixture, the error branch by the share_mode(0) fixture that asserts scope_complete stays false
limitations: Only sharing violations count, so a directory held open in a way that still permits DELETE is not reported — that is deliberate, since guessing would produce false alarms
Directories are sampled under LOCK_PROBE_LIMIT together with files; a tree with more than 200 entries is not fully probed and the preview says it sampled
No process identification: the preview names the directory, not the program holding it
Item 347 stays unchecked: mapped executable images and permission-problem cases remain undetected
